title: Meshcore. Mastodon daily top. Sun 2026-11-22
html:
1. Is there a #MeshCore or #Meshtastic community in #Boston / #CambridgeMA / #SomervilleMA …

Neil Van Dyke (@neilvandyke) · 🔁 14 · ❤️ 9 · 💬 4

Show post

Is there a #MeshCore or #Meshtastic community in #Boston / #CambridgeMA / #SomervilleMA that is *hardcore* "open", in a Fedi kind of way?

Every time I look into participating and hosting a relay, I see that an official app is closed, the firmware for an attractive device is closed and requires additional $ to unlock a feature, complaints someone unilaterally grabbed a trademark, an already small project forking again, a community using Discord, a map site leaking traffic to CloudFlare, etc.

2. #MeshCore is pretty neat but people gotta cool it with the 95% slopcoded ancillary …

stellated (@stellated@mastodon.sdf.org) · 🔁 3 · ❤️ 6 · 💬 1

Show post

#MeshCore is pretty neat but people gotta cool it with the 95% slopcoded ancillary projects and the slopcoded, ugly, near-unusable websites (*glares at CascadiaMesh.*) It is so off-putting and makes me not really wanna graduate beyond mild tinkering to active participation in the community.

3. Hallo, ich sortiere meinen Elektronikfundus aus und habe einen batteriebetriebenen Node …

Flauschfläche :antifa: (@nofollownoindex@mastodon.trueten.de) · 🔁 4 · ❤️ 2 · 💬 1 · 🖼 2

Show post

Hallo, ich sortiere meinen Elektronikfundus aus und habe einen batteriebetriebenen Node im selbstgedruckten Gehäuse kostenlos (bei Versand gg. Porto) abzugeben. Der #heltecv4 hat leider den Knubbel auf dem Resetknopf verloren, mein Workaround dafür war ein Stück zusammengewickelte Alufolie - daher auch keine Knöpfe im Gehäusedruck.
#Fedigive #Meshcore #Meshtastic #Geschenkt #Stuttgart
Edit: ist weg!
